completeCurrentProcedureCard.name: Find Familiar

operational.targets: One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; summons one Small spirit familiar
operational.resolution: No initial roll. The familiar's commanded attack uses your spell attack bonus.
operational.effect: Summon one Small spirit familiar using the shared standard companion profile: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP equal to 2 times your class level, Speed 30 feet, saves equal to your PB, other checks +0, and one melee or ranged attack with 5-foot reach or 30-foot range using your spell attack bonus and dealing S d6 damage of bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage (choose one type and melee or ranged mode on casting; keep them fixed for that summon). It acts immediately after you. While within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, your Bonus Action can command it to move and make its one attack or take another basic action; without a command it may move and Dodge.
operational.scaling: Uses the shared companion profile: AC increases with PB, HP equals 2×class level, and attack damage is S d6 at class levels 1/5/11/17.
operational.limitations: All companions you own share one Bonus Action command and one damaging companion action total per round. The familiar gains no unstated flight, invisibility, telepathy, special senses, resistances, immunities, spell delivery, independent spellcasting, Help-based automatic advantage, loot, wages, corpse, resource generation, death trigger, or free resummon benefit. It disappears at 0 HP or when concentration ends. Recasting replaces your prior familiar from this spell. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, and V/S/F components are retained. The source provides no specific familiar statistics, so the existing shared standard-companion profile is used rather than importing another game's familiar block. Command range/perception and anti-loop limits follow the current playtest companion interface.

originalCatalogRecord.name: Friends

operational.targets: Self, keyed to one creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect; actual hostility is resolved only after casting costs commit.
operational.duration: Up to 1 minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; outside initiative, expires 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve that original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. An already-passed start never counts.
operational.resolution: No save is added. After costs commit, determine whether the chosen creature is actually non-hostile toward you. If not, create no benefit and give no separate hostility diagnostic. If eligible, you gain advantage on actual Charisma checks directly interacting with that creature for the duration.
operational.effect: The benefit includes whatever actual Charisma skill/task is legitimately used in that interaction, not only Persuasion or Deception. It does not grant an otherwise unavailable check or determine its outcome. If the creature becomes actually hostile toward you while the application lasts, this application ends and does not resume merely because its attitude later improves. Hidden but established hostility is still actual; a faction, species, alignment, reputation score, appearance or suspicion alone does not establish it. One active Friends target per caster; a successful eligible new application replaces the old one. A cast that creates no eligible benefit does not itself replace an existing valid application.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in damage, range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: This is a caster-side social benefit, not Charmed, an unwilling-to-harm restriction or control of choices/beliefs. No advantage on attacks, saves, ordinary spellcasting or unrelated checks. Written broader mental/Enchantment defenses retain their actual scope. No automatic post-expiry hostility, notification, friendship, loyalty, confession or reputation change is added. Ordinary observers can notice casting and infer things from actual interactions; the spell does not erase those observations. After initial legal application there is no continuing 30-foot tether, but any actual interaction still needs its normal communication and task permissions. A successful replacement owns its new endpoint; stale cleanup cannot erase it. A failed or countered new cast creates no replacement, though independently required concentration/contact endings still occur. Actual class access, repertoire, components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base 0 RP does not waive Action/components or Refrain. A failed, blocked or countered cast refunds no committed cost and restores no old concentration. V is audible and S needs its normal usable hand; subtle names do not hide casting. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC, with ordinary binary save rules. Creature type alone grants no mental immunity. Actual mental/Enchantment/other defenses apply only within their written scope; immunity only to Charmed does not automatically block a spell that never imposes Charmed. No automatic cantrip scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/V,S and advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature. CONFLICT RULING: Self keyed to a creature selected within the raw 30 feet; NEW one-minute duration replaces Instantaneous metadata. NEW: post-payment hostility test, actual hostility ending and one eligible target/application per caster.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending
